payload.core_mechanism_summary: Generate all beautiful numbers up to n by formula (2^i-1)*2^(i-1) for i in range, test divisibility, take max. Exhaustive candidate check without pruning or state space exploration.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively enumerates all possible beautiful numbers as candidates and tests divisibility, a plain complete search. No backtracking, DFS, DP, or bitmask is used. Among provided subtypes, search_backtracking is the most generic complete_search label, though it does not actually perform backtracking recursion.
